Image Description: 

The image depicts a white, irregularly shaped oval with a wavy outline, set against a black background. The oval shape is the primary focus of the image, and it appears to be made up of small, rounded dots that are connected to form the outline. The background of the image is solid black, providing a stark contrast to the white oval.

The overall effect of the image is one of simplicity and elegance, with the white oval standing out prominently against the black background.
